usage: 太陽 is a noun referring to the star at the center of our solar system.
You can use 太陽 to talk about daytime and sunlight in general.
太陽 can be combined with other words to describe weather or time of day, like in 太陽光 (sunlight) or 太陽落山 (sunset).
Use 太陽 as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing things related to the sun.
太陽 is often used in simple sentences about nature, weather, or astronomy.
